Video type: Tony Stark really died in Endgame
facts: Robert Downey Jr. returns as a brand-new villain: Victor von Doom, not Tony.
column3: Tony Stark really died in Endgame. Robert Downey Junior returns as a brand new villain: Victor von Doom, not Tony.

Video type: Steve Rogers stayed in the past with Peggy
facts: That Endgame ending is why the trailer shows him with Peggy and their son.

Video type: Sam Wilson is Captain America now
facts: Steve handed him the shield in Endgame. In Doomsday, two Captain Americas share the screen.

Video type: Loki was warned of a multiversal war
facts: In Loki's first season, He Who Remains said his variants would start a war across universes.

Video type: The Ten Rings sent a mystery signal
facts: In Shang-Chi's mid-credits scene, the rings beam a message. Nobody knows where. Simu Liu is back.

Video type: Doctor Strange's spell cracked the multiverse
facts: In No Way Home, villains from other Spider-Man worlds broke through, and the world forgot Peter Parker.

Video type: Doctor Strange 2 introduced incursions
facts: When two universes collide, both can be destroyed. It's the multiverse's biggest danger.

Video type: Clea said Strange caused an incursion
facts: In the mid-credits scene, Charlize Theron's Clea pulls him into another dimension to fix it.

Video type: Shuri is the new Black Panther
facts: Wakanda Forever ended with her in the suit. She, M'Baku and Namor all return in Doomsday.

Video type: Loki now holds the multiverse together
facts: Loki's season 2 finale left him on a throne, holding every timeline. Tom Hiddleston is back.

Video type: The Marvels showed Kelsey Grammer's Beast
facts: Its post-credits scene woke Monica Rambeau in an X-Men world. Grammer's Beast returns in Doomsday.

Video type: Marvel got the X-Men from Fox
facts: Disney bought Fox in 2019. Deadpool & Wolverine was the first film to mix Fox heroes into the MCU.

Video type: Lost worlds end up in the Void
facts: Deadpool & Wolverine showed where the TVA throws them. Theory: Doomsday's last battle goes there.

Video type: Wolverine's metal is now in the MCU
facts: Captain America: Brave New World found adamantium inside a giant Celestial's body in the Indian Ocean.

Video type: Samuel Sterns warned of other worlds
facts: In Brave New World's post-credits scene, he tells Sam that something from other worlds is coming.

Video type: The Thunderbolts became the New Avengers
facts: Valentina renamed the team at the end of Thunderbolts. Yelena, Bucky and Red Guardian are back.

Video type: They spotted the Fantastic Four's ship
facts: Thunderbolts' post-credits scene shows a ship from another universe with a giant 4 on it.

Video type: Bob, the Sentry, is still dangerous
facts: He fears his dark side, the Void, will return. Lewis Pullman plays him again in Doomsday.

Video type: The Fantastic Four live on another Earth
facts: First Steps is set on a different Earth with a retro 1960s look, not the Avengers' Earth.

Video type: Doom met baby Franklin
facts: First Steps' mid-credits scene: a hooded Doom sits beside Sue's son. The Russo brothers shot it.

Video type: The Fantastic Four will return in Doomsday
facts: First Steps said so on screen. Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn and Ebon Moss-Bachrach are back.

Video type: Theory: Doom wants Franklin's power
facts: In the comics, Franklin is so powerful that he can create whole universes.

Video type: Spider-Man was last seen in space
facts: Brand New Day's post-credits scene tracks him there. Marvel hasn't said if he's in Doomsday.

Video type: The Hulk sits this one out
facts: Mark Ruffalo confirmed he isn't in Doomsday. Brand New Day hints at why.

Video type: Disney+ lists 15 titles to watch first
facts: Its official list even starts with X-Men and X2. Doomsday hits cinemas on 18 December 2026!
column3: Disney Plus lists fifteen titles to watch first, and it even starts with X-Men and X-Two. Avengers Doomsday hits cinemas on the eighteenth of December!
